decisions.reason: As a waterproof lined safety-shoe range, it likely serves a useful cold/wet-work niche, though variant-heavy PPE lines are often pruned if volumes are modest or replaced by updated models.

An electrostatic-dissipative occupational shoe fits a stable industrial safety requirement and is therefore relatively likely to remain in the assortment unless certification, demand, or overlap issues arise.
A general safety-shoe series is close to the firm’s core business and would usually be kept unless it underperformed badly or was superseded by a refreshed series.
